text: Still, Pharaoh and his chiefs refused. So Allah sent them sign after sign.
"So We sent upon them the flood, and locusts, and lice, and frogs, and blood, as distinct signs."
Each time a sign came, they begged Musa: pray to your Lord for us. If you remove it, we will believe, and let the Children of Israel go.
And each time it was lifted, they broke their promise.
But they were arrogant, and a criminal people.
Until at last, Allah inspired Musa: "Travel by night with My servants. Indeed, you will be pursued."
